m3-sigma-composition.title: Sigma composition: single-site shared_floor, idempotence, G byte-identical, sigma_lapsampling present-zero
m3-sigma-composition.imperative: Implement sigma_cell = sqrt(sigma0^2 + shared_floor^2 + g_sigma_onesided^2 + sigma_lapsampling^2) at one structural site: shared_floor = sqrt(fit_two_way(...).var_circuit) per channel, priced via a single helper function that calls pool_random_effects(shared_floor=...) exactly once per resolved cell. Write tests: (i) single-site -- mock.patch.object the module's pool_random_effects (wraps=real) and assert call_count == number of resolved cells; (ii) idempotence -- rerunning the fit on identical inputs yields byte-identical sigma (no cross-run compounding) PLUS a direct helper-level check that one application != a naive double-application; (iii) G byte-identical point -- two fits differing only in g_sigma_onesided assert identical mean, differing sigma; (iv) sigma_lapsampling present-but-zero -- assert the component is wired (nonzero input measurably widens sigma) and defaults to exactly zero contribution when NULL (not dropped from the formula). TDD red -> green.
